verdict.rationale: Brex exposes REST APIs (Accounting, Budgets, Team, Webhooks) and an MCP server, which enable programmatic/headless automation, and even publishes an llms.txt for agent discovery. However, no OpenAPI spec is publicly resolvable (404s) and there's no evidence of CLI/SDK tooling or CI-specific integration guidance, so support for full headless automation is unproven beyond basic API access.
